code.finding: Concurrent withPerf calls with the same operation name would collide on mark names — fixed by adding a per-invocation counter to mark/measure names

PerformanceMeasure entries must be cleared after creation (performance.clearMeasures) to prevent unbounded accumulation in long sessions
404 check was using error.status but Axios puts HTTP status on error.response.status

Login flow duplicated across journeys intentionally for sub-phase timing isolation

workflow: GSD executor agents commit directly to whatever branch is checked out — planning commits that land on main can be moved to a feature branch before push via git checkout -b + git reset --hard origin/main
